accepted.title: Accessing Aerial Transformation of Arylmethanamines into Amides Using a Redox-Active Aryl-Substituted BIAN-Based Catalyst
accepted.abstract: Abstract The direct α-oxygenation of arylmethanamines to amides is a cornerstone transformation in organic synthesis; however, traditional methods suffer from harsh conditions, reactive reagents, and expensive transition metal catalysts. This study introduces a novel approach using a redox-active aryl-substituted bis(imino)acenaphthene (Ar-BIAN)-based organic radical anion as a catalyst that mimics transition metal catalysis in the aerial oxidation of arylmethanamines into their corresponding amides for the first time. This protocol showcases a wide substrate scope along with tolerance of common organic functional groups. Through various experiments and theoretical calculations, a plausible mechanism has been proposed, involving dehydrogenation of amine to nitrile and its subsequent hydrolysis to amide.
accepted.titleZh: 氧化还原活性芳基取代BIAN催化芳基甲胺空气氧化制备酰胺
accepted.reason: 建立芳基取代BIAN有机自由基阴离子催化的空气氧化方法，将芳基甲胺直接转化为相应酰胺。
accepted.evidenceBasis: fresh compact摘要明确给出芳基甲胺到酰胺的α-氧化、空气作为氧化来源、Ar-BIAN自由基阴离子催化，并明确称具有wide substrate scope和常见有机官能团耐受性；机理提出胺先脱氢为腈再水解为酰胺。
accepted.challengeReason: 论文含催化剂氧化还原行为、实验和理论机理研究，但这些内容解释已明确展示宽底物范围的胺到酰胺制备方法；不是仅有催化剂性能或单一示范反应。

scopeAssessment.primaryContribution: 用无过渡金属的Ar-BIAN自由基阴离子催化剂实现芳基甲胺在空气中的直接酰胺化。
scopeAssessment.preparativeTransformation: 芳基甲胺经α-氧化/脱氢形成腈并水解，制得相应酰胺。
scopeAssessment.generalityEvidence: 摘要明确报告wide substrate scope并耐受常见有机官能团，表明方法跨越多个芳基甲胺而非单一底物。
scopeAssessment.sourceEvidence: fresh compact中的Crossref摘要直接陈述催化剂类别、空气氧化、底物到产物关系、宽范围及官能团耐受性。
scopeAssessment.boundaryChallenge: 虽然研究包含机理计算且催化剂是新设计重点，但主要可迁移能力是宽范围芳基甲胺到酰胺的实际制备转化，符合一般有机合成方法。

accepted.title: Polar and e-Radical Strain-Release Strategies for Accessing Functionalized 2-Oxabicyclo[2.1.1]hexan-3-ones from Bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes
accepted.abstract: Abstract 2-Oxabicyclo[2.1.1]hexanes (OBHs) have emerged as valuable saturated aromatic replacements, whereas their lactone analogues, 2-oxabicyclo[2.1.1]hexan-3-ones (OBHOs) remain underexplored, because of limited synthetic access. Herein, we report complementary polar and electrochemical strain-release strategies for the modular synthesis of 1,4-difunctionalized OBHOs from bicyclo[1.1.0]butane carboxylic acids. The two activation modes provide complementary perspectives toward the chemical space expansion of this underexplored scaffold.
accepted.titleZh: 极性与电自由基应变释放策略由双环[1.1.0]丁烷合成功能化2-氧杂双环[2.1.1]己-3-酮
accepted.reason: 开发互补的极性与电化学自由基应变释放模式，由双环[1.1.0]丁烷羧酸模块化构建1,4-双官能团化OBHO骨架。
accepted.evidenceBasis: fresh compact摘要明确指出OBHO内酯骨架因合成途径有限而欠开发，并报告两种互补活化模式从bicyclo[1.1.0]butane carboxylic acids模块化合成1,4-difunctionalized OBHOs。
accepted.challengeReason: 研究动机包含饱和芳环替代物的化学空间扩展，但贡献不是生物活性或材料性能筛选；两条互补成键路径直接解决稀缺骨架的模块化制备，属于砌块/方法学范围。

scopeAssessment.primaryContribution: 为欠开发的2-氧杂双环[2.1.1]己-3-酮建立两种互补的应变释放合成入口。
scopeAssessment.preparativeTransformation: 双环[1.1.0]丁烷羧酸经极性或电化学自由基活化转化为1,4-双官能团化OBHO内酯。
scopeAssessment.generalityEvidence: 摘要明确称modular synthesis并强调两种activation modes互补，可从共同底物平台拓展该骨架化学空间。
scopeAssessment.sourceEvidence: fresh compact Crossref摘要给出起始物类别、两种活化模式、产物骨架与1,4-双官能团化特征。
scopeAssessment.boundaryChallenge: 虽以芳香环生物电子等排体为应用背景，文章核心仍是新骨架的互补模块化制备策略，而非单一功能分子的性能研究。

accepted.title: Regioselective 1,2-Hydroamination of Conjugated Enynes for Accessing Propargylamines via Dual Photoredox/Cobalt Catalysis
accepted.abstract: Abstract The photoredox-catalyzed selective addition of N–H bonds across unactivated 1,3-enynes represents a promising and sustainable transformation, enabling efficient access to high-value-added propargylamines. Current state-of-the-art advancements via photoredox catalysis rely on the α-amino radicals as reactive intermediates, leading to several deficiencies in key aspects such as selectivity and substrate compatibility. Herein, in contrast to the conventional reaction pathway, we first depict a novel photoredox/cobalt-catalyzed regioselective synthesis of propargylamines via propargyl radical-mediated reductive radical-polar crossover followed by a nucleophilic amination of propargyl–cobalt species. Our findings will spark new ideas for developing general strategies to achieve diverse propargyl derivatives from unactivated 1,3-enynes and various nucleophiles.
accepted.titleZh: 光氧化还原/钴双催化共轭烯炔区域选择性1,2-氢胺化制备炔丙胺
accepted.reason: 建立光氧化还原/钴双催化的未活化1,3-烯炔区域选择性1,2-氢胺化，制备高附加值炔丙胺。
accepted.evidenceBasis: fresh compact摘要明确给出未活化1,3-烯炔、N–H键加成、炔丙胺产物，以及炔丙自由基介导的还原性自由基—极性交叉和炔丙基钴物种亲核胺化路径。
accepted.challengeReason: 摘要强调新机理并未列出精确底物数或收率，不能编造规模数据；但其明确将方法定位为从未活化1,3-烯炔和various nucleophiles获得多样炔丙衍生物的一般策略，足以支持纳入。

scopeAssessment.primaryContribution: 以不同于传统α-氨基自由基路径的双催化机制实现烯炔选择性氢胺化。
scopeAssessment.preparativeTransformation: 未活化共轭1,3-烯炔与含N–H亲核体发生1,2-加成，生成炔丙胺。
scopeAssessment.generalityEvidence: 摘要明确提出面向unactivated 1,3-enynes与various nucleophiles的diverse propargyl derivatives一般策略，并解决选择性和底物兼容性问题。
scopeAssessment.sourceEvidence: fresh compact Crossref摘要直接陈述反应伙伴、炔丙胺产物、区域选择性及自由基—极性交叉/钴中间体机制。
scopeAssessment.boundaryChallenge: 尽管机理创新占重要位置，论文仍提供明确的底物类别到高价值炔丙胺的可推广制备反应，并非无制备范围的纯机理工作。

rejected.title: Bench-Stable Rh/Chiraphos Catalyzed Asymmetric Hydrogenation Reaction of Citral and Its Mechanistic Studies

In this work, we report the synthesis of an air-stable rhodium catalyst, [Rh(chiraphos)2]Cl, which enables over 10 recycling cycles in the asymmetric hydrogenation of citral without significant loss of activity or enantioselectivity (total turnover numbers, TONs, up to 10,000), demonstrating markedly improved stability and practical applicability. Combining experimental investigations with density functional theory (DFT) calculations, we systematically elucidate the mechanism of this asymmetric hydrogenation. The results show that the enantioselectivity and stereodependence are determined by the precise recognition of the citral head groups (CHO vs H) by the chiral cavity of the catalyst. Additionally, the chemoselectivity arises from the differences in deformation energies between the rhodium catalyst and citral caused by steric hindrance while maintaining maximum orbital overlap during the double-bond addition step. rejected.evidenceBasis: fresh compact摘要明确报道[Rh(chiraphos)2]Cl的合成、柠檬醛不对称氢化、超过10次循环与总TON最高10,000，并用实验和DFT解释醛基识别、构型依赖及双键加成选择性；摘要只陈述柠檬醛这一底物体系。
rejected.challengeReason: 该研究确有实际有机转化且面向左旋薄荷醇工业路线，不能说没有合成价值；但在缺少不同底物类别和可迁移制备范围时，单底物催化剂稳定性/机理研究不足以按一般有机合成方法纳入。

rejected.title: Chemical-Delithiation-Induced Surface Reconstruction in Layered Oxide Cathodes for High-Performance All-Solid-State Batteries
rejected.abstract: Abstract Developing all-solid-state batteries (ASSBs) based on high-capacity cathodes (e.g., Ni-rich and Li-rich layered oxides) offers a promising route toward next-generation batteries with high energy density and safety. However, under high voltage, the cathode/solid electrolyte (SE) interface suffers from severe chemical degradation due to enhanced cathode–catholyte interactions. Here, we propose a chemical-delithiation-induced surface reconstruction strategy for Li-rich layered oxide cathodes, as a proof of concept, to effectively eliminate cathode-catholyte interfacial chemical degradation in ASSBs. We found that chemical-delithiation treatment by NO2BF4 induces a surface reconstruction of Li-rich layered oxide, forming a cation-disordered subsurface layer, which can then incorporate fluorine alike disordered rock-salt cathodes. Such surface reconstruction passivates the oxidative surface of Li-rich cathode in which oxygen redox is prevalent at high potential, thus eliminating the interfacial chemical degradation during cycling. As a result, the treated Li-rich layered cathode achieved a reversible capacity of ∼300.3 mA h g–1 that is comparable to liquid cells and a capacity retention of 82.3% over 1500 cycles at 1 C. By extending this strategy to Ni-rich layered oxides, we further demonstrate its universality in interfacial chemical design for high-energy-density ASSBs.

rejected.evidenceBasis: fresh compact摘要给出NO2BF4处理富锂层状氧化物、形成阳离子无序亚表层并引入氟，读出为约300.3 mA h g−1容量及1500次循环后的容量保持；研究对象和评价指标均为电池正极/固态电解质界面。
